The shabby and chaotic space is filled with dust and a foul smell of disinfectant mixed with blood.
The noises and cries from people seem to be separated by a layer, hysterical yet somewhat distant.
You try to feel your body—no pain and no restrains. You are relieved that nothing has been done to you.
Those looking at you from above have already gone.
Hella and Hecate aren't here, but you can sense that they are nearby.
You try to stand up, but just as you tilt your head, you see—
Long gray hair, pale face, and blood-soaked bandages wrapped around bullet holes.
You recognize her. You will never forget this lifeless face. You suddenly recall the memory of your life being threatened, which makes you break out in a cold sweat.
It's the person who wants to kill you. She turns and stares at you.
